race.comment: KING OF LIGHT (3) is the one to beat in the Railway. His wins have been better than the winning margins suggest, underlined by strong sectionals that suggest he's set to peak. Fiore sticks with him and he looks the next big thing - if he isn't already - in WA racing. ROCK FEST (13) sneaks into the field despite finishing runner-up in the Peters last week. That ride was very passive after jumping well and now Ben Thompson takes the ride. Jumped an odds-on pop last week and with a touch of luck, he can land the knockout blow. COSMIC CRUSADER (1) is the class horse of the field and has to carry the weight because of that. He has to defy history, but he's a lovable character and he maps to get his chance. He has to be included. BONJOY (6) looks to get a lovely setup here and she looks destined to run well. WESTERN EMPIRE (2) finished runner-up in this last year and carries less weight this time around. Draws well for Lane and is worth keeping safe.
